title: Mannequin Gate 2 Canonical Representation
description: Rectangular grid with gray lines drawn through cell centres. Shade cells so every line passes through exactly two shaded cells, crossing lines have different gate sizes (unshaded cells between a line's two shaded cells), and all unshaded cells are orthogonally connected.

lines.description: Each line lists every cell it passes through, in order, as [row, col]; consecutive cells are 8-neighbours.
